question:
Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word.

Appoint
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Appoint"** means to assign a job or role to someone. (नियुक्त करना)

 
 
• **Example:** The committee will **appoint **a new chairman next week.
 
 
 
• **"Dismiss"** refers to removing someone from their job or position. (बर्खास्त करना)
 
 
• **Example:** The company decided to **dismiss** the employee due to poor performance.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Appoint'** is **'Dismiss'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Instate** (स्थापित करना): To establish or set up in a position.

 
 
• **Example:** The new principal was** instated** last month.
 
 
 
• **Declare** (घोषित करना): To make a formal statement or announcement.
 
 
• **Example:** The government **declared** a state of emergency.
 
 
 
• **Avail** (लाभ उठाना): To make use of an opportunity or resource.
 
 
• **Example:** You should **avail** yourself of the free gym membership.
 
 

38:T84b,
The correct answer is Option 2</
